name: Domino SMS
description: Domino submodule that eases SMS testing by displaying outgoing SMS as Drupal messages (via the SMS Framework) instead of sending them, on non-production environments.
project_description: Domino SMS is a submodule of the Domino project. It is the SMS counterpart of Domino's "display emails as Drupal messages" feature: when enabled on a non-production environment, outgoing SMS messages sent through the SMS Framework (smsframework) module are intercepted and rendered as Drupal status messages instead of being delivered by the configured SMS gateway. This is useful for automated and manual testing (for example verifying one-time passcodes), because the message content is visible on screen and no real SMS is sent. It has no admin UI or credentials of its own; it reads Domino's application_mode and a single display_sms_as_messages flag. Requires the Domino and SMS Framework modules.
